approved_corrections.assessment: Approved as a typographical correction. Line 5 of the snapshot (source-338-working-snapshot.json, block 0) reads 'אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ. אַתָּה עַד אֱמֶת וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ:'. The generated XML has the same line (hymn_of_divine_unity_for_the_fifth_day_paytan.xml:53), with the printed עַד kept exactly in tei:sic and with the stored before/after context around it. In rendered Hebrew, tei:corr changes only the patah (U+05B7) under ayin to a tsere (U+05B5). Consonants and all other marks are the same. The tei:choice is inline in the second tei:l of stanza 3, after the milestone .../fifth_day_paytan/3 at :52. No milestone or tei:pb was moved or split. The pb n=12 for n337.jpg stays at :49. The reason for the correction ('witness', following 'אַתָּה תָעִיד בְּיִחוּדֶֽךָ') is unchanged from the previous review.

limitations: I checked codepoints from the rendered text only. I had no byte or hex dump and ran nothing. That the vowel is the only change comes from my reading plus the builder's NFC normalization and the exact-match behaviour of _locate. The builder does not check it automatically.

So the qamatz form is confirmed only as far as that recorded excerpt goes.

I did not rerun the builder or the schema validation. Schema validity (12/12) comes from draft-schema-report.json.
